resolutions.researcher_notes: MoP 'Midstream Projects' page (via Wayback, since the live URL 404s) lists 'Establishment and operating of Assiut / Suhag LPG Pipeline with length of 114 km & 12" diameter' under projects completed 2017/2018 -- confirms Fuel=LPG (it's the pipeline's own name/category). Egyptoil-Gas independently reports 'the progress of the 127km Assiut/Sohag pipeline...to transfer LPG to the Sohag filling plant' -- also LPG. Two independent sources agree on fuel type.

Neither the MoP midstream-projects page nor the Egyptoil-Gas article classifies the line as transmission vs. distribution/gathering -- no source found that states a pipeline-type category for this line.

MoP page: 'Establishment and operating of Assiut / Suhag LPG Pipeline...' listed among 'Projects completed during 2017/2018' -- explicit that the line was completed and put into operation. Single source; the 2015-dated Egyptoil-Gas article predates this (describes it as still under review) so it can't corroborate current operating status.
Listed by MoP under 'First: Projects completed during 2017/2018' -- dateline supports StartYear1=2017 (per prose/dateline-equivalence). Single source.

MoP page states the length as exactly '114 km', matching the sheet. NOT combined with the other two sources found, which disagree: Egyptoil-Gas (2015) says 127km, and EGPC's own InProgOperProj.aspx project table also says the 'Assuit/Sohag Loop' is 127km/10" -- both describe what may be a later loop/duplication phase distinct from the original 114km/12" line, or a length discrepancy in one of the sources. Flagging the disagreement rather than citing the conflicting figures; only the exact-match source is used.

MoP page states '12" diameter', matching the sheet exactly. Flagging a disagreement, not citing it: EGPC's own InProgOperProj.aspx page lists the same-named 'Assuit / Sohag Loop' as 10"/127km (a duplication/looping phase, per its own LPG-distribution-upgrade project list), which conflicts with 12in. Left out of proposed_refs per the no-orphan-support rule.
No source found names 'Gahdam' or 'Manfalut' as the pipeline's start point -- both sources describe the line only as 'Assiut/Suhag', with no intermediate/origin place-name detail.

Egyptoil-Gas: pipeline 'will be linked to the Shukeir/Assuit pipeline to transfer LPG to the Sohag FILLING PLANT' -- matches 'Sohag LPG Filling Station' closely. MoP page names the project 'Assiut/Suhag LPG Pipeline' consistent with the same Sohag LPG filling terminus. Two independent sources agree on the Sohag filling-station endpoint.
